title: A registration needs a name and a valid email
statement: Registration MUST be rejected when the name is blank or the email is missing or not an email address.

title: An email already registered is refused
statement: Registration MUST be rejected when a member with the same email (ignoring case) exists, and the librarian MUST be told the email is taken.

title: The new member is shown with their ID
statement: A successful registration MUST show the new member as recorded, with the member ID assigned for their card.

title: A tool needs a name
statement: Adding a tool MUST be rejected when the name is blank.

title: A new tool is available at once
statement: A new tool MUST start in `good` condition and MUST appear in the catalog as available.

title: The added tool reads the same in the catalog
statement: Once a tool is added, the catalog MUST list it exactly as the library showed it, so that the librarian sees one state of the tool wherever they look.

title: The loan is shown with its due date
statement: A successful borrow MUST tell the member the loan's due date (TL-LEND-INV04): a date, not a time.

title: An unavailable tool is refused with the reason
statement: Borrowing MUST be refused when the tool is on loan or needs repair, and the member MUST be told which.

title: A member who cannot borrow is refused with the reason
statement: Borrowing MUST be refused when the member has an overdue loan or already holds 3 active loans, and the member MUST be told which.

title: An unknown member or tool is reported as not found
statement: Borrowing MUST be refused when the member or the tool does not exist, and the member MUST be told which.

title: A return needs a condition
statement: A return MUST be rejected unless it records the condition as `good` or `needs_repair`.

title: A tool returned in good condition is available again
statement: After a return in `good` condition the tool MUST appear as available, unless damage was reported on it during the loan: then it MUST stay `needs_repair` until a librarian marks it repaired (TL-LEND-INV02).

title: A tool returned needing repair is taken out of lending
statement: After a return in `needs_repair` condition the tool MUST be marked as needing repair, with the return note as its damage note, and MUST NOT be lent.

title: A late return is flagged
statement: The librarian SHOULD be told whether the return was late, that is, on a day after the due date in the library's time zone. A return at any time on the due date is not late.

title: The librarian finds the loan from the tool
statement: The librarian MUST be able to find the active loan of the tool brought back, with its member and due date, and MUST be told when the tool is not on loan.

title: A librarian can mark a tool as needing repair, with a note
statement: A librarian MUST be able to mark a tool as needing repair. A note describing the damage is required.

title: Damage reported during a loan does not end the loan
statement: Reporting damage on a tool that is on loan MUST NOT end the loan; the member still returns it in the usual way. The reported damage stays after the return, even if the return records the tool as `good` (TL-LEND-INV02).

title: The damaged tool reads the same in the catalog
statement: Once damage is reported on a tool, the catalog MUST list the tool exactly as the library showed it, so that the librarian sees one state of the tool wherever they look.

title: Marking a tool repaired returns it to lending
statement: A librarian MUST be able to mark a tool that needs repair as repaired, which sets it to `good`, clears the damage note and makes it available. Marking a tool in good condition as repaired MUST be refused.

title: The repaired tool reads the same in the catalog
statement: Once a tool is marked repaired, the catalog MUST list it exactly as the library showed it, so that the librarian sees one state of the tool wherever they look.
